h: Kwankwaso says Tinubu does not deserve a second term
p: Opposition figure Rabiu Kwankwaso has said President Tinubu has not earned a second term, criticising the administration's record on the economy and cost of living. The APC maintains its reforms are working and will be defended on the campaign trail.
more: Kwankwaso is a leading figure in the NDC alliance.
The APC points to its 90-day cost-of-living plan.
Campaign rhetoric is expected to sharpen after the Kaduna flag-off.
